question: In 1706, Tranquebar became the birthplace of Protestant missions in India with the arrival of Bartholomäus Ziegenbalg and Heinrich Plütschau. Which Christian mission did they represent?
explanation: Bartholomäus Ziegenbalg and Heinrich Plütschau arrived in Tranquebar in 1706 as part of the Danish-Halle Mission, marking the beginning of the first Protestant missionary work in India.

question: Bartholomäus Ziegenbalg established a famous printing press at Tranquebar in 1712. What was the first major religious work printed in an Indian language by this press?
explanation: The printing press at Tranquebar, set up by Ziegenbalg, printed the New Testament translated into Tamil in 1715, which was the first translation of the Bible into any Indian language.
